issues.on_page: Bond Maintenance Costs 1,600 (Debt Service Fund column)
issues.issue: This is a Debt Service Fund cost tied to the bonds (paying agent/trustee type fees), which points to debt service interest (fees included), not streets. The detail line for the same label (detail[20], p5) uses general government / professional/contract services, so the two are inconsistent.
Could be debt service interest (detail_category debt interest and fees). It does not match the streets/highways category given to the same line in disbursements[0].
